docs/PRODUCT.md — Recovery Candidate lifecycle.

NEEDS_REVIEW ─▶ IN_REVIEW ─▶ CONFIRMED ─▶ NOTICE_DRAFTED
                      └──▶ REJECTED
(inputs change → recalculation → new immutable RecoveryCalculation;

TreatyVersionStatus.description:
Lifecycle of one treaty version (the immutable executable unit).

DRAFT ──▶ PARSING ──▶ EXTRACTING ──▶ NEEDS_VALIDATION ──▶ VALIDATED ──▶ ACTIVE
                                             └──────────────┘
                      (post-validation change → new version; old → SUPERSEDED)
